environment: Native Safari on Landing iPhone 16 Simulator, iOS 18.6
method: Isolated real AccountRoutes/SQLite test session; actual built Couchside UI; native Simulator taps and native Safari Page Zoom menus. External QA-only metrics measured pre-focus scale, active control font, shared floor, layout width and orientation. Scroll helper revealed status without focusing it.

source_proof.note: Native page was loaded before later JavaScript and stylesheet builds. The early font-floor guard version still matches the current build. The full native-loaded stylesheet was not byte-reverified after later UI changes; measured control fonts and focus scales apply to the native-loaded versions shown here. Module behavior and later Remove buttons are covered separately by root integration tests. This local origin was first visited during this QA run.

measurements.interaction: Real native tap toggled owner-scoped device preference on; checkbox target font measured, not a text-keyboard focus.

conclusion: Both real tracking selects independently retained pre-focus scale at 100% and 85% Page Zoom in portrait and landscape. Fonts and shared floor were 16px at 100% and 19px at 85%. Real list search also retained scale with its visible software keyboard in portrait at both zoom levels.
limits: Simulator evidence, not a physical iPhone test.
No native iPad or split-view rerun.

Real-client software keyboard search was tested in portrait; no independent landscape text-input focus was measured in this real-client run. Both new tracking selects were independently tapped in landscape at both zoom levels.
Experimental checkbox was measured at 100% portrait only; select and search floor compensation at 85% was measured separately.
Pinch zoom was preserved in viewport configuration but no native pinch gesture was rerun.
Metrics overlay and authentication bootstrap exist only in a temporary test server and are absent from production source.
